slice: Gestion Auto queue #12 A3 - ADMIN state & feedback coherence
method: code-first audit of admin/src/pages + admin/src/components (lists, detail, forms), browser confirmation of changed/uncertain screens in fr + ar
notification_mechanism: react-toastify via utils/helper.ts: helper.error(err?, message?) -> toast.error(message || commonStrings.GENERIC_ERROR); helper.info(message) -> toast.info(message). GA pages additionally use MUI Alert for page-level load/action errors.

dominant_patterns.loading: Fetch in try/catch/finally with setLoading(false) in finally; indicator = SimpleBackdrop (CircularProgress + PLEASE_WAIT/LOADING text) on detail/update pages, inline CircularProgress/ellipsis or DataGrid loading prop on lists/GA panels. Resolves on success AND error.
dominant_patterns.empty: Card variant=outlined className=empty-list with Typography color=textSecondary {strings.EMPTY_LIST} (per-list lang file, fr/ar/en/es) when rows empty and not loading - Car/Supplier/Location/Country/Notification lists. GA panels use their own __empty div + localized EMPTY string. DataGrid lists (Booking/User) were the outliers (fixed F11).
dominant_patterns.error: Fetch failure -> helper.error toast (GENERIC_ERROR or api message) AND, on detail/update pages, error/formError state -> root pages/Error (GENERIC_ERROR + GO_TO_HOME). GA pages -> MUI Alert (LOAD_ERROR/strings.ERROR) + toast. No screen should end blank or with a stuck spinner.
dominant_patterns.success_feedback: Two co-dominant variants by flow: stay-on-page updates/creates -> helper.info toast (UPDATED, *_CREATED, SETTINGS_UPDATED, PASSWORD_UPDATE); navigate-away creates/deletes -> navigation to the list (CreateCar->/cars, CreateUser->/users, deletes->list). GA in-place pages -> dialog closes + row/list visibly updates (Team, Maintenance, Payments, Cash, Approbations, ContractOperations).
dominant_patterns.destructive_confirmation: MUI Dialog disableEscapeKeyDown maxWidth=xs, DialogTitle commonStrings.CONFIRM_TITLE, body DELETE_* string, Cancel variant=contained btn-secondary, confirm variant=contained color=error DELETE. Used by BookingList, CarList, UserList, SupplierList, LocationList, CountryList, NotificationList, Avatar, and Car/Supplier/User/UpdateBooking detail pages. Lists with linked records first show a CANNOT_DELETE info dialog.
dominant_patterns.form_validation: RHF + zod resolver, mode onSubmit; fields error={!!errors.x} + helperText/FormHelperText errors.x.message; Car/Supplier create+update also pass onError -> setFocus(first error field). GA dialog forms: manual checks -> formError/sessionError state + MUI Alert inside/above the dialog.
